title: Implement daily dataset: blended $/1M output tokens by model/region/tier
creator: Logan Wright
description:
Goal
Create the canonical aggregated dataset powering the internal Unit Economics dashboard: daily blended cost expressed as $/1M output tokens, sliceable by model, region, and customer tier.

This ticket is explicitly about the daily aggregate table/view (not UI), with agreed grain + partition strategy + late-event handling.

Context
The dashboard needs a finance-aligned metric definition (see PM-483) and a stable, low-cardinality dataset that can back drilldowns without requiring per-request querying. This dataset will become the primary input to the semantic layer views and the dashboard backend query endpoints.

Proposed output
1) Curated table (daily partitions)
- Name (proposed): analytics.unit_econ_daily
- Grain: 1 row per (ds, region, customer_tier, model_family, model_variant)
- Partitioning: partition by ds (UTC)
- Clustering (if supported): region, customer_tier, model_family, model_variant

2) Metric columns (v1)
- output_tokens (sum)
- input_tokens (sum) [included for context + future efficiency metrics]
- requests (count distinct request_id) [approx ok if needed]
- blended_cost_usd (sum) = compute_cost_usd + overhead_allocated_usd (+ other allocs per canonical definition)
- blended_cost_per_1m_output_tokens_usd = (blended_cost_usd / nullif(output_tokens,0)) * 1e6

3) Required dimensions (v1)
- ds: DATE (UTC)
- region: normalized region name used by routing (e.g., us-east, us-west, eu-west)
- customer_tier: one of self_serve | dedicated | private | enterprise (historically correct mapping; depends on ENG-2911)
- model_family: normalized family name (e.g., llama, mistral, qwen) (mapping table-owned; we should avoid freeform strings)
- model_variant: runtime model identifier as exposed in metering (e.g., llama-3.1-70b-instruct) (stable normalized key)

Non-goals (for this ticket)
- Per-account slices (explicitly out of scope due to access control + cardinality)
- Route/runtime_config/quantization_profile slicing (tracked separately; see ENG-2912)
- Dashboard API endpoints (ENG-2915)

Key requirements / constraints
- Finance reconciliation: dataset totals must tie to billing/metering within agreed tolerance once ENG-2914 is live.
- Cardinality guardrails: ensure this dataset stays within reasonable daily row counts (no request-level identifiers, no prompt hashes, no per-account).
- Late-arriving telemetry: define a consistent approach for backfilling/rewriting recent partitions.

Implementation notes
- Source tables: metering_events (token counts + model/region tags) joined to cost attribution outputs (GPU-minute attribution + overhead allocation) at the appropriate aggregation step.
- Event time vs ingestion time: use event_timestamp truncated to UTC date for ds; late events will be corrected via partition rewrite.
- Backfill window: always rewrite ds in [today-2, today] on each run; allow manual historical backfill via runbook tooling (ENG-2918 / runbook).
- Null / low-volume handling: for slices with output_tokens=0, set blended_cost_per_1m_output_tokens_usd to NULL (avoid inf).

Acceptance criteria
- analytics.unit_econ_daily exists in prod analytics project/warehouse and is updated daily.
- Table has documented schema (column descriptions) and stable dimension values (no accidental new tiers/regions).
- Unit tests / data tests cover:
  - ds partitioning present
  - customer_tier constrained to enumerated set
  - region constrained to known regions mapping table
  - output_tokens >= 0, blended_cost_usd >= 0 (with explicit exceptions documented)
  - basic sanity: blended_cost_per_1m_output_tokens_usd within configured bounds (alerting handled in ENG-2917, but tests should catch egregious errors)
- Example queries added to doc (internal) for: daily trend, model mix comparison, region comparison.
- Owner + oncall routing documented (Telemetry/Analytics Platform).

Links / references
- Epic: PM-482 Internal unit economics dashboard
- Metrics definition alignment: PM-483
- Tier mapping table: ENG-2911
- Reconciliation job: ENG-2914
- Data quality monitoring: ENG-2917
comments: 2025-02-06 (Logan Wright): Creating ENG tickets for the dataset workstream. Please keep this dataset intentionally low-cardinality; route/config breakdowns come later once we’ve proven query latency + guardrails.

2025-02-07 (Mei Lin): Drafted schema proposal and partition strategy in pipeline notes. Confirming with Finance whether blended_cost_usd includes overhead allocation at daily level vs post-agg (preference: allocate before daily aggregation so slices add up cleanly).

2025-02-10 (Rishi Malhotra): FP&A request: keep blended_cost_usd and output_tokens as first-class columns so we can recompute ratios and validate with our own checks. Also please ensure ds is UTC and consistent with billing daily cutoffs.

2025-02-11 (Thomas Baird): Cardinality note: model_variant should be normalized to our internal model_id (no ephemeral suffixes). If we see >~2k rows/day from accidental tags (e.g., canary names), we should hard-fail the job and page platform during business hours.

2025-02-13 (Nadia Rahman): Late events: recommend deterministic partition rewrite for ds in [T-2, T] each run. We’ve seen up to ~30h lag in some eu-west metering during incidents; rewriting last 3 partitions is safer than trying to do incremental merges.

2025-02-14 (Mei Lin): Implemented initial aggregation in staging. Remaining: integrate tier mapping join (blocked on ENG-2911 table landing in analytics), and add data tests for tier/region constraints.

2025-02-18 (Logan Wright): Please sync with Cole (reconciliation) on column naming so ENG-2914 can consume without extra translation. We want a single canonical definition of blended_cost_usd across datasets.

2025-02-20 (Mei Lin): Updated pipeline to emit both blended_cost_usd and compute_cost_usd (compute exposed for debugging; dashboard will use blended). Pending final decision from PM-483 on credits/discount handling so we don’t ship a definition that Finance rejects.
